import unittest
from rosterkit.notices import build_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from datetime import date

STUDENT = Student("1", "Doe", "Jane", "A")

def mark(student_id, day, status):
    return Mark(student_id, date(2026, 3, day), status)

class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absences_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            mark("1", 5, "absent"),
            mark("1", 4, "present"),
            mark("1", 2, "absent")
        ]
        text = build_notice(STUDENT, marks)
        self.assertIn("Jane Doe missed 2 day(s)", text)
        self.assertIn("2026-03-02, 2026-03-05", text)

    def test_other_student_rejected(self):
        marks = [mark("2", 2, "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_notice(STUDENT, marks)

    def test_no_absences_rejected(self):
        marks = [mark("1", 2, "excused")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_notice(STUDENT, marks)
